claims.claim: AutoGrow begins with a shallow seed network and incrementally adds layers when doing so improves accuracy, stopping when additional depth no longer yields benefit under the learned policy.
The proposed AutoGrow approach attains strong accuracy‑computation trade‑offs across several benchmark datasets.

summary: AutoGrow proposes a method to automatically grow layers in deep convolutional networks, starting from a shallow seed and expanding when accuracy improves, halting when further depth yields no benefit under a learned policy, demonstrating strong accuracy-computation trade-offs on multiple datasets.
